settings.placement_help: On phones, and on layouts without a visible sidebar, the sidebar choice shows at the top of the list. Bespoke, FoF Widgets and Page Builder can also place it; this spot steps aside wherever one of them shows it.
settings.placement_none: Only where a widget host places it
settings.discussion_page: Also beside discussions, under the scrubber
settings.mode_help: One per discussion keeps a single busy discussion from filling the list.
settings.first_posts: Include new discussions that have no replies yet
settings.excerpt: Show an excerpt of each reply
settings.excerpt_help: Only the reply's own words: spoilers, code, quotes and embeds are left out.
settings.tags_help: Leave every tag on Any to list them all. On a tag's page, the widget shows that tag.
